resources.string: Open Food Facts does not know the code %1$s. You can create this food: it will keep its barcode and be recognised the next time you scan it.
The code %1$s was read, but Open Food Facts could not be reached. Create the food by hand: the code stays attached to it.

Scanning reads the barcode on the phone: no image leaves it. The one that carried the reading stays with the dish if you confirm it, and can be removed in a single gesture. The three other ways of adding a food remain available.
